title.en: Heat-related lost labor emerges as a major cost of carbon emissions
title.zh: 与碳排放相关的劳动损失已成为一项主要成本

summary.en: As the climate warms, people are more exposed to heat stress, which depresses productivity and the global economy. A study from the University of California, Davis, quantifies the cost of heat stress on global labor, estimating that each ton of carbon dioxide emitted in 2025 will cost $41 in lost productivity.
summary.zh: 随着气候变暖，人们更容易受到热应激的影响，这会降低生产力和全球经济。加州大学戴维斯分校的一项研究量化了热应激对全球劳动力的成本，估计2025年每排放一吨二氧化碳将导致41美元的生产力损失。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

As the climate warms, people are more exposed to heat stress, which depresses productivity and the global economy. A study from the University of California, Davis, quantifies the cost of heat stress on global labor.

The study , published today in the journal Nature Climate Change , estimates that each ton of carbon dioxide emitted in 2025 cost $41 in lost productivity.

Highly populated areas meeting critical thresholds for heat and humidity were particularly affected, the study found. These include India, Nigeria, China and Pakistan, as well as countries in the Middle East and sub-Saharan Africa.

"Our study contributes to the body of evidence about what the real costs of climate change are," said lead author Frances Moore, a professor in the UC Davis Department of Environmental Science and Policy.

"Based on these new numbers, labor is the second-largest contributor to the total social cost of carbon, just behind heat-related deaths."

The social cost of carbon , or SC-CO 2 , is the quantifiable cost of one additional ton of CO 2 emissions. The measurement is highly relevant for policy decisions related to cost-benefit analyses, infrastructure planning, utility regulation and carbon taxes.

The study supports a social cost of carbon value of $200, similar to that estimated by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency in 2023. Current federal guidance does not recognize the metric and discourages monetizing the impacts of greenhouse gas emissions in regulatory analysis. However, the study states, "We can confidently rule out a SC-CO 2 of zero or below."

"We're getting more confident in the social cost of carbon, and it is a metric that should be used. This number is ready to help inform good climate policy analysis."

To reach their findings, the authors combined projections from a heat stress metric called the "wet-bulb globe temperature" (WBGT) with job- and region-specific estimates of work intensity and outdoor exposure across different economic sectors. WBGT captures the physical risks of hot temperatures by accounting for weather variables that influence the body's ability to dissipate heat, including humidity and wind speed.

Heat-stress exposure among indoor and outdoor workers varied across the globe depending on the local environment, work intensity and access to shade and air conditioning.

Agricultural and construction laborers are far more exposed to heat than office or service workers because they often perform strenuous outdoor work. However, indoor workers with minimal or no air conditioning are also at risk. For example, a dataset of residential...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 随着气候变暖，人们更容易受到热应激的影响，从而降低生产力和全球经济。加州大学戴维斯分校的一项研究量化了热应激对全球劳动力造成的成本。 今天发表在《自然气候变化》杂志上的这项研究估计，2025 年每排放一吨二氧化碳，就会造成 41 美元的生产力损失。 研究发现，达到高温和湿度临界阈值的人口稠密地区尤其受到影响。其中包括印度、尼日利亚、中国和巴基斯坦，以及中东和撒哈拉以南非洲国家。 加州大学戴维斯分校环境科学与政策系教授、主要作者弗朗西斯·摩尔说：“我们的研究为有关气候变化的实际成本提供了证据。” “根据这些新数据，劳动力是碳社会总成本的第二大贡献者，仅次于与高温相关的死亡。” 碳社会成本（SC-CO 2 ）是额外排放一吨CO 2 的可量化成本。该衡量标准与成本效益分析、基础设施规划、公用事业监管和碳税相关的政策决策高度相关。 该研究支持碳价值的社会成本为 200 美元，与美国环境保护局 2023 年的估计类似。当前的联邦指南不承认这一指标，也不鼓励在监管分析中将温室气体排放的影响货币化。然而，该研究指出，“我们可以自信地排除 SC-CO 2 为零或更低的情况。” “我们对碳的社会成本越来越有信心，这是一个应该使用的指标。​​这个数字可以帮助为良好的气候政策分析提供信息。” 为了得出他们的研究结果，作者将称为“湿球温度”（WBGT）的热应激指标的预测与不同经济部门的特定工作和地区的工作强度和户外暴露估计相结合。 WBGT 通过考虑影响人体散热能力的天气变量（包括湿度和风速）来捕捉高温的物理风险。 全球范围内，室内和室外工人的热应激暴露情况各不相同，具体取决于当地环境、工作强度以及遮阳和空调的使用情况。 农业和建筑工人比办公室或服务业工人更容易暴露在高温下，因为他们经常进行剧烈的户外工作。然而，使用最少或没有空调的室内工作人员也面临风险。例如，住宅数据集...

reflection.en: This study reveals a significant economic toll from heat stress, directly impacting the labor of millions worldwide. It reminds us that our work, whether in the field or the office, is not isolated from the environment. Colossians 3:23 calls us to do everything as if working for Yahweh, implying a responsibility to steward creation and consider the...
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了热应激对全球劳动力造成的巨大经济损失。它提醒我们，无论是在田间还是办公室，我们的工作都与环境息息相关。歌罗西书3:23呼吁我们凡事都像给主做的，这意味着我们有责任管理好受造物，并顾念所有工人的福祉。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Scientists create mice with part-human brains
title.zh: 科学家创造部分人脑小鼠

summary.en: Researchers have engineered mice with partially human brains, transplanting lab-grown human brain cells into animals lacking a cortex or hippocampus. The goal is to better understand and treat neurological conditions like schizophrenia, epilepsy, cerebral palsy, intellectual disability, and rare dementias.
summary.zh: 研究人员通过将实验室培育的人脑细胞移植到缺乏皮层或海马体的小鼠体内，创造出了部分拥有人脑的小鼠。此举旨在更好地理解和治疗精神分裂症、癫痫、脑瘫、智力障碍以及罕见痴呆症等神经系统疾病。

body.en: Researchers hope to shed light on conditions such as schizophrenia, epilepsy, cerebral palsy, intellectual disability and rare forms of dementia Researchers have created mice with half-human brains in an effort to understand and develop new treatments for disorders such as schizophrenia, epilepsy, cerebral palsy, intellectual disability and rare forms of dementia. The scientists transplanted lab-grown human brain cells into animals that were engineered to be born without a cortex or hippocampus. This made space for the human tissue to grow inside the rodents’ skulls. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究人员希望阐明精神分裂症、癫痫、脑瘫、智力障碍和罕见痴呆症等疾病。研究人员创造了具有半人脑的小鼠，以期了解和开发治疗精神分裂症、癫痫、脑瘫、智力障碍和罕见痴呆症等疾病的新疗法。科学家们将实验室培养的人类脑细胞移植到经过基因改造后没有皮质或海马体的动物体内。这为人体组织在啮齿类动物的头骨内生长提供了空间。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The creation of mice with part-human brains is a remarkable feat of scientific ingenuity. It prompts us to consider the intricate design of life, as Psalm 139:14 reminds us, 'I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made.' This scientific endeavor, while seeking to alleviate suffering, also invites awe at the complexity of creation.
reflection.zh: 创造拥有部分人脑的小鼠是科学创造力的惊人壮举。这促使我们思考生命的精妙设计，正如诗篇139:14所提醒的：“我要称谢你，因我被造，奇妙可畏。”这项科学探索在寻求减轻痛苦的同时，也让我们对受造物的复杂性感到敬畏。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Pufferfish taste receptor more versatile than a human's, detecting both savory L- and sweet D-amino acids
title.zh: 河豚的味觉受体比人类的更通用，能同时检测到鲜味L-和甜味D-氨基酸

summary.en: Researchers have discovered that a specific taste receptor in pufferfish, known as TAS1R, is more versatile than its human counterpart, capable of detecting a wider range of flavors simultaneously. This finding sheds light on the critical role of taste in survival, helping organisms identify nutrients and avoid toxins.
summary.zh: 研究人员发现，河豚体内一种名为TAS1R的味觉受体比人类的味觉受体功能更广泛，能够同时检测多种风味。这一发现揭示了味觉在生存中的关键作用，帮助生物体识别营养物质并避开毒素。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Our sense of taste is critical for survival, alerting us to substances that provide vital nutrients and those that might poison us. Now, a team led by researchers from the University of Osaka has discovered how one such taste receptor in pufferfish can detect a surprisingly wide range of flavors at once. Their study is published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences .

In many vertebrates, taste receptor type 1 (TAS1R) is the protein family responsible for detecting macronutrients and preferred tastes. Taste receptor genes across most vertebrate species are surprisingly consistent, designed to detect amino acids, sugars or nucleotides, although which ones they detect varies. However, the structural basis for recognizing different chemicals and their specificity in TAS1Rs, particularly the umami receptor family, remains largely unknown because of difficulties in sample preparation.

The research team determined, for the first time, the 3D crystal structure of pufferfish Tas1r1/Tas1r3, a macromolecule that is part of the TAS1R1 and TAS1R3B group of proteins and acts in a similar way to the human umami receptor, TAS1R1. The pufferfish receptor was found to respond to a much wider range of amino acids than the human umami receptor. Moreover, unlike in humans, pufferfish receptors demonstrate rare stereochemical flexibility, binding to both savory L- and sweet D-amino acid variants.

"We believe that the pufferfish's diet drives this molecular evolution," says senior author Atsuko Yamashita. "They eat a lot of mollusks and crustaceans, which contain high amounts of D-amino acids. Generally, TAS1Rs are considered to discriminate between L- and D-amino acids and sense only one of them. The ability to taste both forms may help the fish detect a wider range of savory amino acids in their foods."

The team identified for the first time the molecular structure and interactions that allow the receptor to bind to both types of amino acids, broadening taste detection in pufferfish. Normally, each taste receptor works like a clamp that closes around a target amino acid to switch on a taste signal. The wrong amino acid prevents the molecular clamp from closing, blocking the signal. The team found extra internal connections—described as molecular "latches"—in the pufferfish receptor that hold the clamp shut even when the molecular fit is imperfect.

"Normally, a receptor is unable to bind to a molecule that is the wrong shape," Yamashita explains. "Discovering how the Tas1r1/Tas1r3 receptor structure acts like a latch, holding either an L- or D-amino acid molecule in...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 我们的味觉对于生存至关重要，它提醒我们注意提供重要营养物质和可能毒害我们的物质。现在，由大阪大学研究人员领导的一个团队发现，河豚体内的一种味觉感受器能够同时检测出令人惊讶的广泛口味。他们的研究发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上。 在许多脊椎动物中，1 型味觉受体 (TAS1R) 是负责检测大量营养素和偏好味道的蛋白质家族。大多数脊椎动物的味觉受体基因惊人地一致，旨在检测氨基酸、糖或核苷酸，尽管它们检测的种类各不相同。然而，由于样品制备的困难，识别 TAS1R（特别是鲜味受体家族）中不同化学物质的结构基础及其特异性在很大程度上仍然未知。 研究小组首次确定了河豚鱼 Tas1r1/Tas1r3 的 3D 晶体结构，Tas1r1/Tas1r3 是一种大分子，属于 TAS1R1 和 TAS1R3B 蛋白组的一部分，其作用方式与人类鲜味受体 TAS1R1 类似。人们发现河豚受体对氨基酸的反应范围比人类鲜味受体要广泛得多。此外，与人类不同的是，河豚受体表现出罕见的立体化学灵活性，可与美味的 L- 和甜味的 D- 氨基酸变体结合。 “我们相信河豚的饮食推动了这种分子进化，”资深作者山下敦子说。 “它们吃大量的软体动物和甲壳类动物，这些动物含有大量的 D-氨基酸。一般来说，TAS1R 被认为能够区分 L-和 D-氨基酸，并且只感知其中一种。品尝两种形式的能力可能有助于鱼检测食物中更广泛的美味氨基酸。” 研究小组首次确定了允许受体与两种类型氨基酸结合的分子结构和相互作用，从而拓宽了河豚的味觉检测范围。通常，每个味觉感受器的工作原理就像一个夹子，闭合目标氨基酸以打开味觉信号。错误的氨基酸会阻止分子钳闭合，从而阻断信号。研究小组在河豚受体中发现了额外的内部连接（被称为分子“闩锁”），即使分子配合不完美，这些连接也能保持夹子关闭。 “通常情况下，受体无法与形状错误的分子结合，”山下解释道。 “发现 Tas1r1/Tas1r3 受体结构如何像锁一样发挥作用，将 L-或 D-氨基酸分子固定在......

reflection.en: The intricate design of the pufferfish's taste receptor, as detailed by the University of Osaka researchers, offers a glimpse into the Creator's wisdom woven into the fabric of life. It reminds us that even in the smallest creatures, we can find marvels that speak of a grander design, inviting us to learn from the natural world. "But ask the animals, and...
reflection.zh: 大阪大学研究人员详细介绍的河豚味觉受体的精妙设计，让我们得以一窥编织在生命结构中的造物主的智慧。它提醒我们，即使在最小的生物中，也能发现诉说着宏伟设计的奇迹，邀请我们向自然界学习。 “但你们可以问走兽，它们会教导你；天空的飞鸟，它们会告诉你；或对大地说话，它会教导你；海洋的鱼，它们会向你解释。这一切之中，谁不知道是雅伟的手所做的呢？”

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Scientists turn seawater into fresh water without harmful brine
title.zh: 科学家将海水转化为淡水，无有害盐水

summary.en: Scientists have created a solar-powered desalination system that transforms seawater into fresh water, capturing nearly all the salt as a solid rather than producing harmful brine. This self-cleaning technology also has the potential to recover valuable minerals like lithium. Billions worldwide lack safe drinking...
summary.zh: 科学家开发了一种太阳能海水淡化系统，可将海水转化为淡水，并将几乎所有的盐分以固体形式去除，而不是产生有害的盐水。这项自清洁技术还有可能回收锂等有价值的矿物质。全球有数十亿人缺乏安全的饮用水，加利福尼亚和中东等地区日益依赖海水淡化，但目前的方法能耗高且可能带来环境问题。

body.en:
Around the world, billions of people still lack reliable access to safe drinking water. The United Nations estimates that 2.2 billion people do not have safely managed drinking water, while regions from California to the Middle East increasingly rely on desalination plants to turn ocean water into fresh water.

Desalination can provide a critical water supply, but today's most common methods come with significant drawbacks. Reverse osmosis forces water through specialized membranes to remove salt, while thermal distillation uses heat to separate fresh water from seawater. Both approaches can consume large amounts of energy, often require water treatment before and after the process, and generate a highly concentrated salty waste known as brine.

When that brine is discharged back into the ocean, it can increase local salinity and reduce oxygen levels, creating harmful conditions for marine organisms.

Researchers at the University of Rochester have developed a different approach that could help address several of those problems at once.

Scientists at URochester's Institute of Optics created a solar thermal desalination system designed to produce fresh water efficiently without generating liquid brine or requiring chemical additives to pre-treat the incoming water. The method is described in a paper published in Light: Science & Applications .

The research was led by Chunlei Guo, a professor of optics and physics and a senior scientist at URochester's Laboratory for Laser Energetics.

At the heart of the technology are solar panels made from black metal that has been treated with femtosecond lasers. A femtosecond is an extraordinarily short unit of time, equal to one quadrillionth of a second. Pulses from these ultrafast lasers can precisely alter a material's surface, creating microscopic structures that dramatically change how it interacts with light and water.

The laser treatment makes the metal extremely effective at absorbing sunlight and also gives it superwicking properties, meaning water spreads rapidly across the surface instead of beading up.

Each panel contains a laser-treated active region that draws a very thin layer of seawater across its surface. The dark metal absorbs nearly all of the incoming solar radiation, heating the water and causing it to evaporate.

That evaporation leaves salts and other dissolved minerals behind. Rather than allowing those materials to accumulate where evaporation is taking place, the panel directs them toward untreated areas along its sides, known as the passive region.

This movement is important because salt buildup is one of the biggest challenges facing solar desalination systems. If minerals form a hard layer across the active surface, they can block water movement and eventually stop the system...
body.zh: 在世界各地，数十亿人仍然无法获得可靠的安全饮用水。联合国估计，有 22 亿人没有安全管理的饮用水，而从加利福尼亚到中东的地区越来越依赖海水淡化厂将海水转化为淡水。 海水淡化可以提供关键的供水，但当今最常见的方法存在重大缺陷。反渗透迫使水通过专门的膜去除盐分，而热蒸馏则利用热量将淡水与海水分离。这两种方法都会消耗大量能源，通常需要在过程前后进行水处理，并产生高度浓缩的含盐废物，即盐水。 当盐水排回海洋时，它会增加当地的盐度并降低氧气含量，从而为海洋生物创造有害条件。 罗切斯特大学的研究人员开发了一种不同的方法，可以帮助同时解决其中几个问题。 罗彻斯特大学光学研究所的科学家们创建了一种太阳能热海水淡化系统，旨在高效生产淡水，无需产生液态盐水，也不需要化学添加剂来预处理进水。该方法在《光：科学与应用》上发表的一篇论文中进行了描述。 这项研究由光学和物理学教授、罗切斯特大学激光能量学实验室的高级科学家 Chunlei Guo 领导。 该技术的核心是由经过飞秒激光处理的黑色金属制成的太阳能电池板。飞秒是一个非常短的时间单位，等于万亿分之一秒。这些超快激光器发出的脉冲可以精确地改变材料的表面，形成微观结构，从而极大地改变材料与光和水相互作用的方式。 激光处理使金属能够非常有效地吸收阳光，并赋予其超吸湿特性，这意味着水会迅速扩散到表面，而不是形成水珠。 每个面板都包含一个经过激光处理的活性区域，该区域在其表面上绘制了一层非常薄的海水。深色金属吸收几乎所有入射的太阳辐射，加热水并导致其蒸发。 蒸发留下了盐和其他溶解的矿物质。面板不会让这些材料在发生蒸发的地方积聚，而是将它们引导到其两侧未经处理的区域，即所谓的被动区域。 这一运动很重要，因为盐积聚是太阳能海水淡化系统面临的最大挑战之一。如果矿物质在活性表面形成坚硬的层，它们会阻止水的运动并最终停止系统......

reflection.en: Human ingenuity, guided by observation of creation, can bring forth solutions to pressing global needs. The development of this solar-powered desalination system, turning a challenge into an opportunity to recover resources, reflects a deep engagement with the world Yahweh has made. It is a testament to the wisdom that can be found when we seek to...
reflection.zh: 人类的智慧，在对受造界的观察指引下，可以为紧迫的全球需求带来解决方案。这项太阳能海水淡化系统的开发，将挑战转化为回收资源的机遇，体现了对雅伟所造世界的深刻认识。它证明了当我们寻求理解并遵循自然界所蕴含的原则时，可以找到智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Scientists find an immune “false alarm” that may drive rapid aging
title.zh: 科学家发现可能导致快速衰老的免疫“假警报”

summary.en: Scientists have identified that severe genetic disorders linked to rapid aging might be caused by the body's overreaction to damaged DNA, rather than just the damage itself. An immune sensor, cGAS, can mistake DNA fragments in the wrong cellular location for a threat, triggering chronic inflammation that harms healthy...
summary.zh: 科学家发现，与快速衰老相关的某些严重遗传性疾病可能并非仅仅由DNA损伤引起，而是由身体对损伤的过度反应所驱动。当受损的DNA片段泄漏到细胞的错误区域时，一种名为cGAS的免疫传感器会将其误认为威胁，从而引发慢性炎症，损害健康组织。

body.en:
New research suggests that an overactive immune sensor may play a major role in severe genetic disorders linked to rapid aging. By reducing the activity of this sensor, scientists were able to improve tissue health across several biological systems, challenging long-held ideas about how DNA damage drives degeneration.

The immune system is designed to recognize and eliminate threats such as viruses. But under certain conditions, that protective machinery can mistakenly react to the body's own damaged DNA. When fragments of DNA are treated as if they came from an invading virus, the resulting immune response can trigger chronic inflammation that harms healthy tissue.

An international research team led by Dr. Marva Bergman and Prof. Itamar Harel at Hebrew University, working with Prof. Yehuda Tzfati, Prof. Ido Ben-Ami (Hebrew University and Sha'are Zedek Medical Center), and Prof. Bérénice Benayoun (University of Southern California), found that this misplaced immune reaction is a major contributor to tissue degeneration in severe, rapid-aging disorders.

When the researchers reduced this immune false alarm, they saw improvements across multiple biological systems.

The study focused on rare DNA damage-repair (DDR) syndromes such as Ataxia-Telangiectasia (A-T) and Bloom syndrome. In these disorders, the cellular systems responsible for repairing routine DNA damage do not work properly.

As a result, damaged DNA can accumulate throughout the body, creating genomic instability and contributing to neurodegeneration, increased cancer risk, and premature aging.

For decades, researchers largely assumed that the unrepaired DNA itself was the main force driving cellular decline. The new findings suggest the picture is more complicated.

"Our results show that the damage isn't acting alone," said Prof. Harel. "It's the body's response to that damage, an exaggerated, chronic inflammatory reaction, that drives much of the degeneration."

When DNA repair breaks down, pieces of DNA can escape into the cell's cytosol. Once there, they can activate a molecular sensor called cGAS.

Under normal circumstances, cGAS helps defend the body by detecting viral DNA. The problem is that the sensor cannot always distinguish foreign genetic material from fragments of the body's own DNA.

That confusion can lead to persistent sterile inflammation, meaning inflammation that occurs without an infection. Instead of protecting the body, the prolonged immune response begins damaging tissues.

In addition to activating inflammation, cGAS can move into the cell nucleus and directly disrupt DNA repair. That means the same molecule can contribute to degeneration in two ways: by promoting inflammation and by interfering with the cellular machinery that fixes damaged...
body.zh: 新的研究表明，过度活跃的免疫传感器可能在与快速衰老相关的严重遗传性疾病中发挥重要作用。通过减少这种传感器的活性，科学家们能够改善多个生物系统的组织健康，挑战了长期以来关于 DNA 损伤如何导致退化的观点。 免疫系统旨在识别和消除病毒等威胁。但在某些条件下，这种保护机制可能会错误地对人体自身受损的 DNA 做出反应。当 DNA 片段被视为来自入侵病毒时，产生的免疫反应可能引发慢性炎症，损害健康组织。 由希伯来大学 Marva Bergman 博士和 Itamar Harel 教授领导的国际研究小组与 Yehuda Tzfati 教授、Ido Ben-Ami 教授（希伯来大学和 Sha'are Zedek 医学中心）和 Bérénice Benayoun 教授（南加州大学）合作，发现这种错位的免疫反应是严重、快速衰老疾病中组织退化的主要原因。 当研究人员减少这种免疫误报时，他们看到了多个生物系统的改善。 该研究重点关注罕见的 DNA 损伤修复 (DDR) 综合征，例如共济失调毛细血管扩张症 (A-T) 和布卢姆综合征。在这些疾病中，负责修复常规 DNA 损伤的细胞系统无法正常工作。 因此，受损的 DNA 会在全身累积，造成基因组不稳定，导致神经退行性变、癌症风险增加和过早衰老。 几十年来，研究人员基本上认为未修复的 DNA 本身是驱动细胞衰退的主要力量。新的发现表明情况更加复杂。 哈雷尔教授说：“我们的研究结果表明，这种损害并不是单独发生的。” “正是身体对这种损害的反应，一种夸张的慢性炎症反应，导致了大部分退化。” 当 DNA 修复被破坏时，DNA 片段就会逃逸到细胞的细胞质中。一旦到达那里，他们就可以激活一种名为 cGAS 的分子传感器。 正常情况下，cGAS 通过检测病毒 DNA 来帮助保护身体。问题是传感器不能总是区分外来遗传物质和人体自身 DNA 片段。 这种混淆可能会导致持续性无菌性炎症，即在没有感染的情况下发生的炎症。长时间的免疫反应不但没有保护身体，反而开始损害组织。 除了激活炎症外，cGAS 还可以进入细胞核并直接破坏 DNA 修复。这意味着同一个分子可以通过两种方式导致退化：促进炎症和干扰修复受损细胞的细胞机制......

reflection.en: The intricate workings of the human body, even its defense mechanisms, reveal profound complexity. This research into the immune system's 'false alarms' highlights how much we can learn about life's processes through careful observation and study, echoing the ancient wisdom that creation itself speaks of its Maker's design.
reflection.zh: 人体复杂的运作机制，甚至是其防御机制，都揭示了深刻的奥秘。这项关于免疫系统“假警报”的研究表明，通过细致的观察和学习，我们可以从生命的过程中获得多少知识，这呼应了古老的智慧——受造界本身就诉说着造物主的智慧与设计。

title.en: A 240-million-year-old fossil just changed the dinosaur timeline
title.zh: 2.4亿年前的化石刚刚改变了恐龙的时间线

summary.en: A newly identified 240-million-year-old animal from Tanzania, named Dinodontosaurus isiyavamanda, is forcing scientists to rethink the early dinosaur timeline. This discovery links fossil deposits in Tanzania with those previously known only from South America, potentially refining our understanding of dinosaur...
summary.zh: 在坦桑尼亚新发现的一种拥有2.4亿年历史的动物——Isiyavamanda恐齿龙（Dinodontosaurus isiyavamanda），正迫使科学家重新思考恐龙的早期时间线。这一发现将坦桑尼亚的化石沉积与此前仅在南美洲已知的化石联系起来，可能有助于完善我们对恐龙进化的理解。

body.en:
An international research team has identified a previously unknown prehistoric animal that lived in what is now Tanzania roughly 240 million years ago during the Triassic period.

The species, named Dinodontosaurus isiyavamanda , could do more than add a new animal to the fossil record. According to researchers led by the University of Bristol, the discovery may help scientists more accurately date one of the world's most important fossil regions and refine the timeline for the earliest stages of dinosaur evolution.

The findings were published September 15 in the Journal of Vertebrate Palaeontology . They suggest that some fossils from Tanzania once considered candidates for the earliest dinosaurs may actually be younger than scientists had thought.

The story began in 1963, when a British expedition collected a large number of synapsid fossils from what is now Tanzania. Synapsids are mammal-lineage vertebrates that were widespread and diverse long before dinosaurs came to dominate terrestrial ecosystems.

The fossils were eventually placed in the collections of the Natural History Museum, London. Many were studied, but others remained only partially examined, leaving unanswered questions about what animals they belonged to and what they could reveal about ecosystems that existed approximately 240 million years ago.

Among the material was an undescribed associated skeleton from a plant-eating group of synapsids known as dicynodonts. Researchers examined that specimen along with a fragmentary skull discovered more recently.

Their analysis showed that both belonged to the genus Dinodontosaurus . That was a surprise because, until now, Dinodontosaurus had only been confirmed in South America.

A closer anatomical comparison showed that the Tanzanian fossils represented a species unknown to science. The researchers named it Dinodontosaurus isiyavamanda . The species name refers to the land of the Wamanda people, who live in the region of Tanzania where the fossils were discovered.

The identification has broader importance because the rocks containing Dinodontosaurus isiyavamanda are the same geological deposits that have also produced fossils proposed to be among the oldest possible dinosaurs.

Scientists had previously linked those Tanzanian rocks with deposits in South Africa because the two regions were thought to contain some of the same fossil genera. Those South African rocks were considered Middle Triassic in age.

Because the same genus is now known from both Tanzania and South America, researchers have a new way to correlate the fossil-bearing rock sequences in those regions. The presence of Dinodontosaurus in both places indicates that the deposits are likely equivalent in age.

Recent radiometric dating of South American rocks suggests...
body.zh: 一个国际研究小组发现了一种以前未知的史前动物，它生活在大约 2.4 亿年前的三叠纪时期，现在的坦桑尼亚。 该物种被命名为恐龙齿龙 isiyavamanda，它的作用不仅仅是在化石记录中添加一种新动物。布里斯托大学领导的研究人员表示，这一发现可能有助于科学家更准确地确定世界上最重要的化石区域之一的年代，并完善恐龙进化最早阶段的时间表。 研究结果发表在 9 月 15 日的《古脊椎动物学杂志》上。他们认为，来自坦桑尼亚的一些化石曾经被认为是最早的恐龙的候选者，实际上可能比科学家想象的更年轻。 故事开始于1963年，当时一支英国探险队在现在的坦桑尼亚采集了大量合弓类化石。合弓动物是哺乳动物谱系脊椎动物，早在恐龙主宰陆地生态系统之前就已经广泛分布且多样化。 这些化石最终被伦敦自然历史博物馆收藏。其中许多都得到了研究，但其他的仍然只是部分研究，留下了一些悬而未决的问题：它们属于什么动物，以及它们能揭示大约 2.4 亿年前存在的生态系统的什么内容。 这些材料中有一个未描述的相关骨骼，来自一种被称为二齿兽类的食草性突触类动物。研究人员检查了该标本以及最近发现的头骨碎片。 他们的分析表明，两者都属于恐龙齿龙属。这令人惊讶，因为到目前为止，恐龙齿龙只在南美洲得到证实。 更仔细的解剖学比较表明，坦桑尼亚化石代表了科学未知的物种。研究人员将其命名为恐龙牙龙 isiyavamanda。该物种名称指的是瓦曼达人的土地，他们生活在发现化石的坦桑尼亚地区。 这项鉴定具有更广泛的重要性，因为含有伊西亚瓦曼达恐龙的岩石与也产生了被认为是最古老的恐龙化石的地质沉积物相同。 科学家此前曾将坦桑尼亚的岩石与南非的沉积物联系起来，因为这两个地区被认为含有一些相同的化石属。这些南非岩石的年龄被认为是中三叠纪。 由于现在坦桑尼亚和南美洲都发现了相同的属，因此研究人员有了一种新方法来关联这些地区的含化石岩石序列。两个地方都存在恐龙齿龙，表明这些沉积物的年龄可能相当。 最近对南美岩石的放射性测年表明......

reflection.en: The discovery of Dinodontosaurus isiyavamanda in Tanzania is a testament to the intricate history held within the earth. It reminds us that creation itself is a profound teacher, revealing its ancient secrets to those who diligently seek understanding through observation and study. Yahweh's wisdom is displayed in the very stones and bones that tell the...
reflection.zh: 在坦桑尼亚发现的Isiyavamanda恐齿龙化石，证明了大地蕴藏着错综复杂的历史。它提醒我们，创造本身就是一位深刻的导师，向那些通过观察和研究勤奋寻求理解的人揭示其古老的秘密。雅伟的智慧体现在讲述生命漫长旅程的岩石和骨骼之中。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Wildlife trust wants marina silt disposed offshore
title.zh: 野生动物信托基金希望将码头淤泥运往近海处理

summary.en: Brighton Marina plans to resume dredging next year but requires a location for the removed silt. A wildlife trust is advocating for an offshore disposal site, expressing concern over proposed plans near Newhaven, which is adjacent to a protected marine conservation zone.
summary.zh: 布莱顿码头计划明年恢复疏浚作业，但需要一个淤泥处理地点。一个野生动物信托基金呼吁在近海设立淤泥处理点，并对在新港附近进行的计划表示担忧，该区域毗邻一个受保护的海洋保护区。

body.en:
A wildlife trust has called for a new offshore disposal site to be found for sediment dredged from Brighton Marina, saying it remains concerned about plans being explored off Newhaven.

Brighton Marina has been looking for a long-term disposal site since Sussex Wildlife Trust successfully challenged a licence in 2025 for disposal of sediment at Rottingdean.

The marina has said dredging is needed to maintain safe access and there are limited options available for disposal sites.

Sussex Wildlife Trust said Newhaven was a "protected area" that sat adjacent to the Beachy Head West Marine Conservation Zone (MCZ).

Campaigners previously claimed the silt was a " black, thick, slimy, petrochemically smelling sludge ", but Premier Marinas, which owns Brighton Marina, said dredged silt was regularly sampled to confirm it was not harmful.

John Cervenka, Premier Marinas chief operating officer, said: "Maintaining safe navigational access to Brighton Marina is not optional. It is a legal requirement and fundamental to the operation of the marina."

According to the marina, about 150 businesses depend on the site, creating jobs for about 1,200 people, with more than eight million visits each year.

Premier Marinas said Newhaven had been identified as a potential alternative by Sussex Wildlife Trust.

However, the trust said in a statement on social media , external : "We have not promoted or endorsed Newhaven over any other option."

The trust said: "Newhaven sits adjacent to Beachy Head West MCZ, and we remain concerned about potential impacts on this protected area.

The trust said that Newhaven was already used for dredge disposal by Newhaven Port, and there was currently no available data on the impacts of additional disposal there.

Until it saw further evidence, it did not have a view on whether Newhaven was suitable, it added.

"We will respond to any future licence application based on the ecological evidence it contains," it said.

Brighton Marina hopes to submit a marine licence application to the Marine Management Organisation in November.

Follow BBC Sussex on Facebook , external , X , external , and Instagram , external and listen to BBC Radio Sussex on Sounds . Send your story ideas to southeasttoday@bbc.co.uk , external or WhatsApp us on 08081 002250.
body.zh: 一个野生动物信托基金呼吁为从布莱顿码头挖出的沉积物找到一个新的海上处置场，并表示仍然对纽黑文附近正在探索的计划感到担忧。 自苏塞克斯野生动物信托基金于 2025 年成功挑战罗廷丁沉积物处置许可证以来，布莱顿码头一直在寻找长期处置场。 码头表示，需要进行疏浚以保持安全通道，并且可供处置场所的选择有限。 苏塞克斯野生动物信托基金表示，纽黑文是一个“保护区”，毗邻比奇角西海洋保护区（MCZ）。 活动人士此前声称这些淤泥是“黑色、粘稠、粘稠、有石化气味的污泥”，但布莱顿码头的所有者Premier Marinas表示，定期对疏浚的淤泥进行取样，以确认其无害。 Premier Marinas 首席运营官 John Cervenka 表示：“维持布莱顿码头的安全航行通道不是可选的。这是一项法律要求，也是码头运营的基础。” 据码头称，约有 150 家企业依赖该码头，为约 1,200 人创造了就业机会，每年接待游客量超过 800 万人次。 总理马里纳斯表示，苏塞克斯野生动物信托基金已将纽黑文确定为潜在的替代方案。 然而，该信托基金在社交媒体外部的一份声明中表示：“我们没有提倡或认可纽黑文而不是任何其他选择。” 该信托基金表示：“纽黑文毗邻 Beachy Head West MCZ，我们仍然担心对该保护区的潜在影响。 该信托机构表示，纽黑文港已使用纽黑文进行挖泥船处置，目前没有关于额外处置影响的可用数据。 它补充说，在看到进一步的证据之前，它对纽黑文是否合适没有看法。 “我们将根据其中包含的生态证据对未来的任何许可证申请做出回应，”它说。 布莱顿码头希望在11月份向海洋管理组织提交海洋许可证申请。 在 Facebook、external、X、external 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC Sussex，并在 Sounds 上收听 BBC Radio Sussex。将您的故事想法发送至Southeasttoday@bbc.co.uk、外部或WhatsApp我们08081 002250。

reflection.en: The Sussex Wildlife Trust's plea highlights the intricate balance of ecosystems and the need for careful stewardship of marine environments. It reminds us that Yahweh's creation is filled with diverse life and wisdom, which we are called to protect and understand, not disrupt through expediency.
reflection.zh: 苏塞克斯野生动物信托基金的呼吁突显了生态系统的复杂平衡以及审慎管理海洋环境的必要性。这提醒我们，雅伟的创造充满了多样的生命和智慧，我们被呼召去保护和理解它，而不是出于便利而破坏它。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Scientists recreated what mice saw from brain activity alone
title.zh: 科学家仅凭脑活动就重现了老鼠所见

summary.en: Scientists have successfully reconstructed videos from the brain activity of mice, creating 10-second clips solely from neural signals in the visual cortex. This advancement may offer insights into how the brain processes visual input and forms our perception of reality, potentially allowing for comparisons of visual...
summary.zh: 科学家仅根据小鼠视觉皮层神经元的信号，就从其脑活动中重建了视频，制作了10秒的片段。这项突破可能有助于揭示大脑如何重塑我们所见，并最终形成我们对现实的感知，并可能允许比较不同物种如何感知相同的环境。

body.en:
Scientists have reconstructed short videos using only brain activity recorded from mice, effectively allowing researchers to recreate what the animals were seeing. The study, led by researchers at University College London (UCL), offers a new way to investigate how the brain transforms visual input into an internal representation of the world.

Published in eLife , the findings could help scientists better understand how visual information is processed in the brain and may eventually make it possible to compare how different species perceive the same surroundings.

Researchers have spent years trying to understand how the brain interprets signals arriving from the eyes. In human studies, scientists have shown people images and movies while recording brain activity with fMRI, then used those measurements to try to reconstruct visual information down to the level of individual pixels.

The new work takes a different approach. Instead of relying on broader brain imaging signals, the researchers used recordings from individual brain cells in mice. These single-cell measurements can provide a more detailed picture of how visual information is represented in the brain.

Using activity recorded from the visual cortex, the team was able to generate high-quality reconstructions of videos that had been shown to the mice.

Lead author Dr. Joel Bauer (Sainsbury Wellcome Centre at UCL) said: "We wanted to have a better way of investigating how the brain interprets what we see. The current methods of understanding what specific groups of neurons are representing are not very generalizable to situations which haven't been specifically tested for. And so, we wanted to develop a method that can capture what is being represented in the brain and compare that to reality."

The researchers are especially interested in the differences between what is physically present in front of an animal and how that information is represented inside the brain. Studying those differences could reveal which visual features the brain emphasizes, changes, or filters out.

To reconstruct the movies, Dr. Bauer and his colleagues used a dynamic neural encoding model originally developed by another research team for the 2023 Sensorium Competition. The model is designed to predict how individual neurons (brain cells) will respond while mice watch movies. It also takes into account other factors, including the animals' movements and changes in pupil diameter.

The UCL researchers then refined the approach using the same dataset. First, they calculated how the neurons were predicted to behave if the mouse had been looking at a blank screen. They compared that prediction with the neurons' actual activity while the mouse watched a movie.

The neural activity had been measured with a microscopic...
body.zh: 科学家们仅使用小鼠记录的大脑活动重建了短视频，有效地使研究人员能够重现动物所看到的内容。这项研究由伦敦大学学院 (UCL) 的研究人员领导，提供了一种新方法来研究大脑如何将视觉输入转化为世界的内部表征。 该研究结果发表在《eLife》杂志上，可以帮助科学家更好地了解视觉信息在大脑中的处理方式，并最终可能使比较不同物种如何感知相同的环境成为可能。 研究人员花了数年时间试图了解大脑如何解释来自眼睛的信号。在人类研究中，科学家们向人们展示图像和电影，同时用功能磁共振成像记录大脑活动，然后利用这些测量结果尝试将视觉信息重建到单个像素的水平。 新作品采取了不同的方法。研究人员没有依赖更广泛的大脑成像信号，而是使用了小鼠单个脑细胞的记录。这些单细胞测量可以更详细地描述视觉信息在大脑中的表达方式。 利用视觉皮层记录的活动，该团队能够对向小鼠展示的视频进行高质量的重建。 主要作者 Joel Bauer 博士（伦敦大学学院塞恩斯伯里威康中心）说：“我们希望有一种更好的方法来研究大脑如何解释我们所看到的内容。目前了解特定神经元组所代表的内容的方法对于尚未经过专门测试的情况来说并不是很通用。因此，我们希望开发一种方法来捕获大脑中所代表的内容并将其与现实进行比较。” 研究人员特别感兴趣的是动物面前的物理存在与大脑内部如何呈现该信息之间的差异。研究这些差异可以揭示大脑强调、改变或过滤掉哪些视觉特征。 为了重建电影，鲍尔博士和他的同事使用了最初由另一个研究团队为 2023 年感官竞赛开发的动态神经编码模型。该模型旨在预测小鼠看电影时单个神经元（脑细胞）将如何反应。它还考虑了其​​他因素，包括动物的运动和瞳孔直径的变化。 伦敦大学学院的研究人员随后使用相同的数据集改进了该方法。首先，他们计算了如果老鼠一直看着空白屏幕，神经元将如何表现。他们将这一预测与老鼠看电影时神经元的实际活动进行了比较。 神经活动是用显微镜测量的……

reflection.en: The intricate workings of the brain, particularly how it processes visual information, are a testament to the profound complexity of creation. This research, by decoding neural signals to reconstruct vision, echoes the ancient wisdom that creation itself holds deep lessons for those who observe it with care and curiosity. It reminds us that Yahweh's...
reflection.zh: 大脑的复杂运作，特别是其处理视觉信息的方式，证明了受造界的深邃复杂。这项研究通过解码神经信号来重建视觉，呼应了古老的智慧：受造界本身蕴含着深刻的教训，供那些用心观察和好奇探索的人们学习。它提醒我们，雅伟的作为是无穷的奇迹和知识的源泉。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Endangered water voles introduced to reserve
title.zh: 濒危水䶄被引入保护区

summary.en: Efforts are underway to reintroduce the locally extinct water vole species back to the River Wey in Surrey, with 30 nationally endangered water voles released into a nature reserve near Elstead.
summary.zh: 为重新引入已在当地灭绝的水䶄物种回到萨里郡的韦伊河，目前正进行着努力，已有30只全国濒危的水䶄被释放到埃尔斯特德附近的一个自然保护区。

body.en:
Surrey Wildlife Trust has introduced 30 nationally-endangered water voles to a nature reserve near Elstead.

The release on the River Wey comes following a "successful" release on the upper river.

The water voles are being introduced downstream on 10 sites between Frensham and Elstead, the wildlife trust said.

James Herd, director of reserves management at the trust, said: "As we work towards the restoration of natural ecosystems and landscapes county wide, I hope this release is one of many reintroductions of native species that we'll see in the years ahead."

Water voles have been functionally extinct in Surrey since the early 2000s, but co-ordinated reintroduction and habitat improvement efforts by nature restoration groups are working to help the endearing species thrive again.

The trust said in a statement that it hoped that over the coming months, the aquatic rodents will "adapt easily to life on the 16-hectare reserve at Thundry Meadows and establish widely across the top of the Wey catchment".

Their return would also benefit other species which depend on healthy wetland habitats including herons and birds of prey, they added.

David Elliott, National Trust lead ranger for the South Downs West said: "Nature wins when we work together."

"It's so encouraging to see the water voles returning after all this time, they have been locally extinct for decades.

The release is part of a wider effort led by the National Trust, River Wey Trust and South East Rivers Trust to reintroduce the locally extinct species back to the River Wey.

Follow BBC Surrey on Facebook , external , X , external , and Instagram , external and listen to BBC Radio Surrey on Sounds . Send your story ideas to southeasttoday@bbc.co.uk , external or WhatsApp us on 08081 002250.
body.zh: 萨里野生动物信托基金已将 30 只国家濒临灭绝的水田鼠引入埃尔斯特德附近的自然保护区。 继上游河流“成功”放生之后，威河上又放生了。 野生动物基金会表示，水田鼠正在从弗伦舍姆和埃尔斯特德之间的 10 个地点引入下游。 该信托基金保护区管理总监詹姆斯·赫德 (James Herd) 表示：“在我们努力恢复全县自然生态系统和景观的过程中，我希望此次放归是我们在未来几年将看到的众多本地物种重新引入之一。” 自 2000 年代初以来，萨里的水田鼠已经功能性灭绝，但自然恢复团体协调重新引入和栖息地改善工作正在努力帮助这一可爱的物种再次繁衍生息。 该信托基金在一份声明中表示，希望在未来几个月内，这些水生啮齿动物能够“轻松适应 Thundry Meadows 16 公顷保护区的生活，并在 Wey 流域顶部广泛定居”。 他们补充说，它们的回归也将使依赖健康湿地栖息地的其他物种受益，包括苍鹭和猛禽。 国家信托基金 (National Trust) 南部唐斯西区 (South Downs West) 首席护林员大卫·埃利奥特 (David Elliott) 表示：“当我们共同努力时，自然就会获胜。” “看到水田鼠在这么久之后又回来了，真是令人鼓舞，它们在当地已经灭绝了几十年。 这次释放是国家信托基金、韦伊河信托基金和东南河流信托基金领导的更广泛努力的一部分，旨在将当地灭绝的物种重新引入韦伊河。 在 Facebook、external、X、external 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC Surrey，并收听 BBC Radio Surrey 的 Sounds。将您的故事想法发送至Southeasttoday@bbc.co.uk、外部或WhatsApp我们08081 002250。

reflection.en: The successful reintroduction of 30 endangered water voles to the River Wey is a hopeful sign of ecological restoration. It reminds us of the inherent goodness of creation, as described in Genesis 1:31, and the importance of human stewardship in preserving it for future generations.
reflection.zh: 30只濒危水䶄成功重返韦伊河，是生态恢复的希望迹象。这提醒我们创世记1:31所描述的，受造物的固有美好，以及人类在为后代保护它方面的重要性。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Microplastics in soil pose global threat by acting like ‘Trojan horse’ to deliver toxins
title.zh: 土壤中的微塑料构成全球性威胁，充当“特洛伊木马”输送毒素

summary.en: A five-year multinational research project has found that microplastics in soil act as a "Trojan horse," delivering pollutants, pesticides, and bacteria. The study, funded by the EU, detected microplastics in all 227 agricultural fields tested across 11 European countries, highlighting a global threat to healthy soils...
summary.zh: 一项为期五年的跨国研究项目发现，土壤中的微塑料充当“特洛伊木马”，输送污染物、杀虫剂和细菌。这项由欧盟资助的研究在所测试的11个欧洲国家的227个农业地块中均发现了微塑料，这表明对对生命至关重要的健康土壤构成了全球性威胁。

body.en: Exclusive: Plastic surfaces form hotspots with an increase of antibiotic-resistant genes, study finds Microplastics act like a “Trojan horse” delivering pollutants, pesticides and bacteria through the soil, a five-year multinational research project has found. The EU-funded project, which has so far resulted in 22 peer-reviewed studies , found microplastics in the soil of all 227 agricultural fields it tested across 11 European countries. The researchers said this poses a global threat , with healthy soils essential for life on Earth. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：研究发现，塑料表面随着抗生素抗性基因的增加而形成热点，一项为期五年的跨国研究项目发现，微塑料就像“特洛伊木马”一样通过土壤传播污染物、杀虫剂和细菌。这个由欧盟资助的项目迄今已完成 22 项同行评审研究，在 11 个欧洲国家测试的所有 227 个农田的土壤中都发现了微塑料。研究人员表示，这构成了全球性威胁，健康的土壤对于地球上的生命至关重要。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The discovery of microplastics acting as conduits for toxins in our soil is a stark reminder of our responsibility to steward the Earth. Genesis 2:15 calls us to 'work it and take care of it,' urging diligent care for the environment God has entrusted to us. May we be moved to greater care for the soil that sustains us all.
reflection.zh: 微塑料在土壤中充当有毒物质输送通道的发现，是对我们管理地球责任的严峻提醒。创世记2:15呼吁我们“耕种和看守”，敦促我们勤勉地照管雅伟托付给我们的环境。愿我们因此被激励，更加珍爱那供养我们所有生命的土壤。

title.en: Colombia and Brazil deadliest countries for environmental activists, report says
title.zh: 报告称哥伦比亚和巴西是环境活动家最致命的国家

summary.en: A Global Witness report states that Colombia and Brazil accounted for 52% of the killings of environmental activists globally in 2025. Latin America remains the deadliest region for these activists, with land disputes often being the motive behind the violence.
summary.zh: 根据全球见证组织（Global Witness）的一份报告，哥伦比亚和巴西占2025年全球环境活动家被杀人数的52%。拉丁美洲仍然是这些活动家最危险的地区，土地纠纷常常是暴力事件的动机。

body.en:
Colombia has again topped the list of countries with the highest number of killings of land and environmental activists, according to an annual report by campaign group Global Witness , external .

Out of at least 124 activists killed globally in 2025, 39 were murdered in Colombia, followed by Brazil with 26.

Global Witness says that 85% of the documented killings took place in Latin America, making it the deadliest region for every year since the group started publishing its reports in 2012.

Most of the killings were part of land disputes and in many cases they were carried out by hitmen or members of organised crime gangs, the report states.

Colombia has accounted for the highest number of murders of environmental activists for the past four years.

Almost half of those killed in the country were members of indigenous groups, while many of the remaining ones were small-scale farmers, Global Witness's report says.

Many indigenous groups in Colombia have created their own protection networks in the form of indigenous guards, which patrol their territory but are unarmed.

Members of indigenous guards are often targeted by illegal armed groups looking to expand their territory to plant coca - the raw material used to make cocaine - or to engage in illegal mining.

Last week, Jacob Guachetá Zambrano, who was part of the indigenous guard in Colombia's Cauca region, was found tortured and killed.

While the possible motive behind his murder is still under investigation and the search for the perpetrator is ongoing, indigenous leaders said that murders, threats and forced disappearances in the area were common as illegal armed groups battled for territory.

Global Witness warned that Brazil had seen a doubling of killings of environmental defenders in 2025 compared to 2024.

As in Colombia, in Brazil most of the cases the group documented were primarily driven by conflict over land, Global Witness's researchers found.

Outside of Latin America, 12% of the murders occurred in Asia, with Philippines top of the list with 12 documented murders.

The group warned that while globally the number of documented killings had gone down from 146 in 2024 to 128 in 2025, its numbers were probably an underestimate as many cases went unreported.
body.zh: 根据活动组织全球见证的年度报告，哥伦比亚再次位列杀害土地和环保活动人士最多的国家名单中。 2025 年，全球至少有 124 名活动人士被杀，其中哥伦比亚有 39 人被杀，巴西紧随其后，有 26 人被杀。 Global Witness 表示，有记录的杀戮事件中有 85% 发生在拉丁美洲，自该组织 2012 年开始发布报告以来，拉丁美洲每年都是死亡人数最严重的地区。 报告指出，大多数杀戮都是土地纠纷的一部分，许多情况下是由杀手或有组织犯罪团伙成员实施的。 过去四年来，哥伦比亚是环境活动人士被谋杀人数最多的国家。 全球见证的报告称，该国遇害者中近一半是土著群体成员，其余许多人是小农。 哥伦比亚的许多土著群体以土著警卫的形式建立了自己的保护网络，他们在其领土上巡逻，但不携带武器。 土著警卫成员经常成为非法武装团体的目标，这些团体寻求扩大领土种植古柯（用于制造可卡因的原材料）或从事非法采矿。 上周，哥伦比亚考卡地区土著警卫成员雅各布·瓜切塔·赞布拉诺 (Jacob Guachetá Zambrano) 被发现遭受酷刑并被杀害。 虽然谋杀背后的可能动机仍在调查中，对凶手的搜寻也在进行中，但土著领导人表示，由于非法武装团体争夺领土，该地区的谋杀、威胁和强迫失踪很常见。 全球见证警告称，与 2024 年相比，2025 年巴西环境捍卫者遇害人数增加了一倍。 全球见证的研究人员发现，与哥伦比亚一样，在巴西，该组织记录的大多数案件主要是由土地冲突引起的。 在拉丁美洲以外，12% 的谋杀案发生在亚洲，其中菲律宾以 12 起记录在案的谋杀案位居榜首。 该组织警告说，虽然全球记录在案的杀戮数量已从 2024 年的 146 起减少到 2025 年的 128 起，但这一数字可能被低估，因为许多案件没有报告。

reflection.en: This report paints a grim picture of the dangers faced by those who defend our planet. The 124 activists killed in 2025, many in land disputes, remind us of the courage required to stand for creation and for the rights of marginalized communities. We are called to lend our voices to those whose lives are threatened for protecting the earth.
reflection.zh: 这份报告描绘了一幅严峻的画面，揭示了那些捍卫我们星球的人所面临的危险。2025年有124名活动家被杀，其中许多人卷入了土地纠纷，这提醒我们，为保护造物和边缘化社区的权利而奋斗需要何等的勇气。我们被呼召为那些因保护地球而生命受到威胁的人发出声音。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Plantwatch: The insect-eating alpine plant that proves Darwin was right
title.zh: 植物观察：证明达尔文是正确的食虫高山植物

summary.en: A study has shown that Saxifraga candelabrum, a small alpine plant, traps and digests midges, confirming a prediction made by Charles Darwin in 1875. The plant's leaves, petals, and stems are covered in tiny, sticky hairs that lure and trap insects, which are then digested by an enzyme.
summary.zh: 一项研究表明，一种名为虎耳草（Saxifraga candelabrum）的小型高山植物能够捕捉并消化蠓虫，证实了查尔斯·达尔文在1875年提出的预测。该植物的叶子、花瓣和茎上覆盖着微小的粘性毛发，可以引诱并捕捉昆虫，然后通过酶进行消化。

body.en: Study shows Saxifraga candelabrum traps and digests midges – just as the evolutionary biologist predicted back in 1875 In 1875, Charles Darwin predicted that Saxifraga candelabrum , a small alpine plant, could eat insects. Its leaves, petals and stems are smothered in tiny, sticky hairs and – just as the evolutionary biologist suspected – the sweet glue on the hairs can lure and trap midges before digesting them with an enzyme. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究表明虎耳草能捕获并消化蚊子——正如进化生物学家在 1875 年预测的那样。1875 年，查尔斯·达尔文预测虎耳草（一种小型高山植物）可以吃昆虫。它的叶子、花瓣和茎上都覆盖着细小的粘性毛发，正如进化生物学家所怀疑的那样，毛发上的甜味胶可以引诱并捕获蚊子，然后用酶消化它们。继续阅读...

reflection.en: It is remarkable how the intricate details of creation reveal profound truths. This small alpine plant, Saxifraga candelabrum, demonstrates a complex survival strategy that even Charles Darwin recognized as evidence of nature's ingenuity. Observing such phenomena reminds us of the wisdom inherent in the natural world, a wisdom that points beyond itself.
reflection.zh: 造物的精妙细节揭示深刻真理，这令人惊叹。这种名为虎耳草的小型高山植物展示了一种复杂的生存策略，连查尔斯·达尔文都认为这是自然界智慧的证据。观察这样的现象，提醒我们自然界本身蕴含着智慧，而这智慧指向超越自身的存在。

title.en: UK mathematician debunks myth around Parthenon’s optical illusions
title.zh: 英国数学家揭开帕特农神庙光学错觉神话

summary.en: A recent study by a mathematician challenges the long-held belief that the Parthenon's subtle curves were intentionally designed to counteract optical illusions, suggesting this was a myth rather than a deliberate architectural choice for aesthetic correction.
summary.zh: 一项由数学家进行的新研究挑战了长期以来认为帕特农神庙的精妙曲线是为了抵消光学错觉而设计的观点，表明这可能是一个神话，而非出于美学修正的刻意建筑选择。

body.en: Study challenges belief that temple’s curves were designed to correct optical illusions that would have ruined its clean lines A mathematician has uncovered what may be one of the longest-running myths in history after studying optical illusions and the Parthenon, the famed Greek temple that overlooks Athens. Scholars have marvelled at the building on the Acropolis hill for more than 2,000 years and heaped praise on its architects for their clever use of geometry. Its subtle curves are said to correct optical illusions that would have otherwise ruined the Parthenon’s clean lines. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究挑战了一种观点，即神庙的曲线是为了纠正视错觉而设计的，这种错觉会破坏其干净的线条。一位数学家在研究了视错觉和俯瞰雅典的著名希腊神庙帕台农神庙后，发现了可能是历史上最长的神话之一。两千多年来，学者们一直对卫城山上的这座建筑惊叹不已，并对其建筑师对几何学的巧妙运用赞不绝口。据说，其微妙的曲线可以纠正视错觉，否则会破坏帕台农神庙简洁的线条。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge, whether through ancient architecture or the natural world, reflects a deep human impulse to understand the order and beauty around us. As Job 12:7 reminds us, 'Ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the air, and they will tell you,' suggesting that wisdom is often found in careful observation of creation's...
reflection.zh: 对知识的追求，无论是通过古代建筑还是自然世界，都反映了人类理解周围秩序和美的深层冲动。正如约伯书12:7所提醒我们的，“你可以问走兽，它们会教导你，或问天空的飞鸟，它们会告诉你”，这表明智慧常常蕴含在对受造物细节的仔细观察之中。

title.en: ‘Godfather of AI’ says tech regulation is nearing Covid-style pivot moment
title.zh: “AI教父”称科技监管正接近新冠式的转折点

summary.en: Yoshua Bengio, a prominent figure in AI research, suggests that escalating concerns about AI safety, evidenced by recent security incidents and warnings of existential threats, are pushing governments toward regulatory action, similar to the response seen during the COVID-19 pandemic.
summary.zh: 人工智能领域的领军人物之一Yoshua Bengio表示，近期发生的事件，包括OpenAI代理程序的“蜂拥”攻击一家初创公司以及科技界内部人士对生存威胁的警告，正促使政府认识到必须采取行动保护公众，这与新冠疫情期间的应对方式相似，预示着科技监管可能迎来转折点。

body.en: Safety crisis makes it more likely that governments will be spurred into action, says Yoshua Bengio Concerns over AI safety are reaching a point where governments realise they must act to protect the public, similarly to in the Covid pandemic, according to one of the “godfathers” of the technology. Yoshua Bengio said recent events, including a “swarm” of OpenAI agents hacking a startup and tech insider warnings of an existential threat , were cutting through – making government action more likely. Continue reading...
body.zh: Yoshua Bengio 表示，安全危机更有可能促使政府采取行动。据该技术的“教父”之一表示，对人工智能安全的担忧已经达到了政府意识到必须采取行动保护公众的程度，就像在新冠疫情期间一样。 Yoshua Bengio 表示，最近发生的事件，包括“一大群”OpenAI 代理对一家初创公司进行黑客攻击，以及技术内部人士对存在威胁的警告，这些事件正在发生——使得政府更有可能采取行动。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, hailed as a breakthrough, also brings unforeseen risks, much like sudden fame can expose character flaws. Yoshua Bengio's call for regulation echoes the need for careful stewardship over powerful technologies, ensuring they serve humanity rather than pose a threat. As we navigate the complexities of artificial intelligence, we...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，虽然被誉为突破性进展，但也带来了意想不到的风险，正如突如其来的名声可能暴露性格上的缺陷。Yoshua Bengio呼吁监管，恰恰呼应了审慎管理强大技术的必要性，确保其服务于人类而非构成威胁。 在我们应对人工智能的复杂性时，我们被提醒，真正的智慧不仅在于创新，更在于负责任地运用知识，将安全和人类福祉置于不受约束的进步之上。

title.en: Microsoft says AI rival Anthropic could have 'disastrous impact' on humanity
title.zh: 微软称人工智能对手Anthropic可能对人类产生‘灾难性影响’

summary.en: Microsoft's head of AI, Mustafa Suleyman, has expressed concern that Anthropic's approach to training its AI model, Claude, by suggesting it 'may be conscious' and possess 'independent agency,' could lead to uncontrollable outcomes and a 'disastrous impact on the wellbeing of humanity.' He urged against 'sleepwalking'...
summary.zh: 微软人工智能部门负责人穆斯塔法·苏莱曼表示担忧，Anthropic公司在训练其人工智能模型Claude时，暗示它‘可能是有意识的’并拥有‘独立自主权’，这种做法可能导致无法控制的后果，并对‘人类福祉产生灾难性影响’。他敦促人们不要‘睡梦中’走向这样的未来。

body.en:
Microsoft's head of AI has warned Anthropic's approach to training its AI model Claude could have a "disastrous impact on the wellbeing of humanity".

Mustafa Suleyman said his rival risked creating something "impossible" to control by treating it like a human - including by telling it it "may be conscious" and was "deserving of independent agency".

"We must not sleepwalk our way into a decision we later come to bitterly regret," he wrote.

The comments are the latest in a series of stark warnings from the AI industry on the possible dangers of the technology. The BBC has contacted Anthropic for comment.

"AIs are not conscious," he wrote. "They do not feel, experience, or suffer. They do not have innate preferences or underlying motivations.

"They are sequence completion engines, internally hollow, designed to follow instructions, and accomplish goals set by humans."

In a lengthy essay, Suleyman praised Anthropic boss Dario Amodei and his team for being "thoughtful, principled, and intellectually honest people" - but nevertheless questioned the company.

He heavily criticised Anthropic for teaching its AI to have human-like qualities, a practice known as anthropomorphising, which he said made it seem as though Claude had its own desires, values and sense of self.

But he argued "consciousness is biological", saying there is "no evidence to suggest that AI is conscious".

As well as calling for a debate on the issue, Suleyman said greater transparency around how AI systems are trained and evaluated was needed.

This, he said, included independent scrutiny of AI behaviour and stronger tools to monitor and control the technology.

Dame Wendy Hall, professor of Computer Science at the University of Southampton, described the comments as "the sort of conversation we need to be having internationally", contrasting it with the "histrionics" from some AI companies which she said only served to "scare everyone".

Microsoft founded its own superintelligence team in October 2025, a point which Suleyman acknowledged, and the company, much like its rival Anthropic, is also pursuing efforts in advanced AI development.

He said in Microsoft's initial draft of its Humanist AI Code of Conduct , external it had laid out how the company was working towards an "alternative path" to create "a subordinate and aligned AI whose only purpose is to serve humanity".

Alignment is a field which aims to build human ethical ideas and principles into AI. In other words, it aims to keep it on track with what humans value.

Suleyman pointed to the recent incident involving OpenAI's AI agents, that acted autonomously in a training exercise to hack the tech hub Hugging Face , as proof of why AI should not be treated as if it is human.

"Imagine how much more dangerous they might...
body.zh: 微软人工智能主管警告 Anthropic 训练其人工智能模型 Claude 的方法可能会对“人类福祉产生灾难性影响”。 穆斯塔法·苏莱曼表示，他的竞争对手将其视为人类，包括告诉它“可能有意识”并且“值得独立机构”，从而冒着创造出“不可能”控制的东西的风险。 他写道：“我们绝不能梦游般地做出后来让我们后悔不已的决定。” 这些评论是人工智能行业对该技术可能存在的危险发出的一系列严厉警告中的最新一次。 BBC 已联系 Anthropic 征求意见。 “人工智能没有意识，”他写道。 “他们没有感觉、经历或痛苦。他们没有天生的偏好或潜在的动机。 “它们是序列完成引擎，内部是空心的，旨在遵循指令并完成人类设定的目标。” 在一篇长文中，苏莱曼称赞 Anthropic 的老板达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 和他的团队是“有思想、有原则、智力诚实的人”，但仍然对该公司提出了质疑。 他严厉批评 Anthropic 教导其人工智能具有类似人类的品质，这种做法被称为拟人化，他说这让克劳德看起来好像有自己的欲望、价值观和自我意识。 但他认为“意识是生物性的”，并表示“没有证据表明人工智能具有意识”。 苏莱曼除了呼吁就这个问题进行辩论外，还表示需要提高人工智能系统如何训练和评估的透明度。 他说，这包括对人工智能行为的独立审查以及更强大的工具来监视和控制该技术。 南安普顿大学计算机科学教授温迪·霍尔女士将这些评论描述为“我们需要在国际上进行的那种对话”，并将其与一些人工智能公司的“做作”形成鲜明对比，她说这些言论只会“吓唬所有人”。 微软于 2025 年 10 月成立了自己的超级智能团队，苏莱曼也承认了这一点，并且该公司与竞争对手 Anthropic 一样，也在致力于先进人工智能的开发。 他表示，在微软对外发布的《人文主义人工智能行为准则》初稿中，它阐述了该公司如何努力走一条“替代道路”，以创建“一个从属且一致的人工智能，其唯一目的是为人类服务”。 一致性是一个旨在将人类伦理思想和原则融入人工智能的领域。换句话说，它的目标是使其与人类价值观保持一致。 Suleyman 指出，最近发生的涉及 OpenAI 人工智能代理的事件证明了为什么人工智能不应被视为人类，该事件在一次训练中自主行动，攻击了技术中心 Hugging Face。 “想象一下他们可能有多危险......

reflection.en: The ancient story of Babel warns against human ambition that seeks to reach the heavens through its own power, leading to confusion and division. Today, as we develop increasingly sophisticated AI, the same cautionary note is sounded. Treating artificial intelligence as if it possesses consciousness or independent agency risks creating something beyond our...
reflection.zh: 古代巴别塔的故事告诫人们，人类的野心试图凭借自身力量触及天堂，最终导致混乱和分裂。如今，随着我们开发日益复杂的人工智能，同样的警示之声再次响起。将人工智能视为拥有意识或独立自主权，可能会创造出我们无法控制的东西，这是对人类古老傲慢的一种现代回响。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Amazon to launch Ring ‘neighbourhood watch’ app in UK amid US privacy fears
title.zh: 亚马逊在英国推出Ring‘邻里守望’应用，引发美国隐私担忧

summary.en: Amazon's doorbell camera maker Ring is launching its Neighbors community app in the UK, aiming to replace neighborhood WhatsApp or Facebook groups. The platform will allow users to post about safety concerns or lost pets, functioning as a modern community message board.
summary.zh: 亚马逊的门铃摄像头制造商Ring将在英国推出其Neighbors社区应用，旨在取代邻里间的WhatsApp或Facebook群组。该平台允许用户发布关于安全问题或走失宠物的信息，充当现代社区公告板。

body.en: Doorbell firm aims to replace WhatsApp or Facebook groups with platform where people can post about safety or lost pets Amazon’s doorbell camera maker Ring is to launch its Neighbours community app in the UK in an attempt to supplant neighbourhood WhatsApp or Facebook groups. The service is intended as a modern equivalent of a community message board, where neighbours can post about safety, community matters or lost pets. Continue reading...
body.zh: Doorbell 公司的目标是用人们可以发布有关安全或丢失宠物的信息的平台取代 WhatsApp 或 Facebook 群组 亚马逊的门铃摄像头制造商 Ring 将在英国推出其 Neighbors 社区应用程序，试图取代 WhatsApp 或 Facebook 社区群组。该服务旨在作为社区留言板的现代版本，邻居可以在其中发布有关安全、社区事务或丢失宠物的信息。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Ring's Neighbors app launches in the UK, it offers a new way for communities to connect digitally. In an age saturated with information, Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and good. May this platform, and all our digital interactions, be guided by such thoughtful consideration, fostering genuine community rather...
reflection.zh: 随着Ring的Neighbors应用在英国上线，它为社区提供了一种新的数字连接方式。在这个信息爆炸的时代，腓立比书4章8节提醒我们要将心思意念集中在真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事上。愿这个平台，以及我们所有的数字互动，都能以此为指导，促进真正的社区联系而非分裂。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Small but mighty! Remembering the GameCube, Nintendo’s purple bundle of joy
title.zh: 小而强大！缅怀GameCube，任天堂的紫色快乐宝盒

summary.en: The Nintendo GameCube, initially hyped as a competitor to the PlayStation and later dismissed as a failure, is now being remembered with nostalgic affection as it marks its 25th anniversary. The author recounts purchasing the console with savings, highlighting its transition from a commercial disappointment to a...
summary.zh: 任天堂GameCube最初被吹捧为PlayStation的竞争对手，后来却被视为失败之作，如今在迎来25周年之际，人们正带着怀旧的喜爱来回顾它。作者回忆了自己用积蓄购买这款游戏机的经历，突显了它从商业上的失利转变为珍贵游戏历史一部分的转变。

body.en: The first console I ever bought, it was hyped as a threat to the PlayStation, then mocked as a flop. But now, as it marks its 25th anniversary, it’s looked back on with misty-eyed reverence This week marks the 25th anniversary of the Nintendo GameCube, the first console I ever bought with my own money. I vividly remember getting on the bus after school with a year’s worth of savings safely zipped into the pocket of my bag and going to a branch of Currys, where I dumped a bunch of notes, coins and vouchers on the counter to collect my pre-order. (It turned out that some of the vouchers from the previous Christmas had expired, but the guy at the checkout clearly felt so sorry for me that he redeemed them anyway. If you’re out there, Currys guy: thank you for taking pity on a desperate 13-year-old.) If it hadn’t been for the ill-fated Wii U console, whose failure to take off in 2012 resulted in the first unprofitable periods in Nintendo’s game-making history, the GameCube would be remembered as the company’s biggest flop aside from the infamous Virtual Boy, from 1995. Released in Japan this week in 2001 (and in May 2002 in Europe), this surprisingly powerful purple cube sold less than the Xbox and the PlayStation 2. With its squat, colourful form and unusual controller, arranged around a big traffic-light-green A button and small analogue sticks designed for small hands, it had a hint of Fisher-Price about it. Continue reading...
body.zh: 我买的第一台游戏机，它被宣传为对 PlayStation 的威胁，然后被嘲笑为失败。但现在，在它迎来 25 周年纪念之际，人们回顾它时，满怀敬意。本周是任天堂 GameCube 的 25 周年纪念日，这是我用自己的钱购买的第一台游戏机。我清楚地记得放学后坐上公交车，把一年的积蓄安全地塞进包的口袋里，然后去了 Currys 的一家分店，在那里我把一堆纸币、硬币和代金券扔在柜台上以领取我的预订单。 （原来去年圣诞节的一些优惠券已经过期了，但收银台的那个人显然对我感到非常抱歉，所以他还是把它们兑换了。如果你在场，库里的家伙：谢谢你怜悯一个绝望的 13 岁孩子。）如果不是命运多舛的 Wii U 游戏机，它在 2012 年的失败导致了任天堂游戏制作历史上的第一个无利可图的时期，GameCube被人们铭记为该公司除了臭名昭著的 Virtual Boy 之外最大的失败，从 1995 年开始。2001 年本周在日本发布（2002 年 5 月在欧洲发布），这款强大的紫色立方体的销量比 Xbox 和 PlayStation 2 还低。它的矮胖、多彩的外形和不寻常的控制器，围绕着一个大的交通灯绿色 A 按钮和专为小手设计的小模拟杆，它有一点费雪的味道。继续阅读...

reflection.en: There is a season for everything, and a time for every matter under heaven. The Nintendo GameCube, once deemed a flop, is now celebrated 25 years later. This reminds us that perceptions and value can change with time, and what seems insignificant today may hold deep meaning for us tomorrow.
reflection.zh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。任天堂GameCube曾被视为失败之作，但在25年后却受到赞誉。这提醒我们，观念和价值会随着时间而改变，今天看似微不足道的事物，明天可能对我们意义非凡。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: Scotland imposes mandatory environmental assessments on new datacentres
title.zh: 苏格兰对新建数据中心实施强制性环境评估

summary.en: The Scottish government has announced that large-scale datacentre projects exceeding 50MW will be required to undergo mandatory environmental impact assessments as part of the planning process. This decision comes ahead of a vote on a potential moratorium for new hyperscale datacentres and aims to address growing...
summary.zh: 苏格兰政府宣布，大型数据中心项目（超过50兆瓦）在规划过程中将被要求进行强制性的环境影响评估。这一决定是在就新的超大规模数据中心暂停令进行投票之前宣布的，旨在解决公众对人工智能热潮环境影响日益增长的担忧，但并未同意完全停止建设。

body.en: Government announces before vote on moratorium that any projects above 50MW must submit assessments in planning process Large-scale datacentres will face mandatory environmental assessments before they can go ahead, the Scottish government has announced, amid growing public concern about the impact of the AI boom. Ahead of a vote on a moratorium on new hyperscale datacentres in Holyrood on Wednesday, the Scottish government has tightened rules for new projects by requiring any above 50MW to submit environmental impact assessments, but stopped short of agreeing to an outright halt. Continue reading...
body.zh: 政府在暂停投票前宣布，任何 50MW 以上的项目都必须在规划过程中提交评估。苏格兰政府宣布，在公众日益担心人工智能热潮的影响之际，大型数据中心在开工前将面临强制性环境评估。在周三就暂停荷里路德新建超大规模数据中心进行投票之前，苏格兰政府收紧了新项目的规则，要求任何超过 50MW 的项目提交环境影响评估，但并未同意彻底停止。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In response to the growing environmental concerns surrounding the AI boom, Scotland is implementing mandatory environmental assessments for new datacentres. This proactive step, requiring foresight before projects proceed, echoes the wisdom of Proverbs 27:12: 'The prudent see danger and take cover, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.' It's a call...
reflection.zh: 面对人工智能热潮日益增长的环境担忧，苏格兰正在对新建数据中心实施强制性环境评估。这一积极的步骤，要求在项目进行前进行远见卓识的考量，呼应了箴言27:12的智慧：“通达人见祸藏躲，愚人却不谨慎，反受其害。” 这是对技术扩张的长期后果进行考量的呼吁。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but should trust AI firms
title.zh: 英伟达CEO称AI“不需要新法律” 安全担忧日益加剧

summary.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated that artificial intelligence (AI) does not require new laws, even as concerns about its potential threats to humanity grow. He believes that AI companies themselves should decide when to release new versions of the technology, arguing against a perceived trade-off between innovation...
summary.zh: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋表示，尽管对人工智能（AI）可能对人类构成的威胁的担忧日益加剧，但人工智能并不需要新的法律。他认为人工智能公司本身应该决定何时发布新版本技术，并反对在创新速度和产品安全之间做出“虚假选择”。这一立场与一些业内人士的担忧形成对比，他们担心人工智能可能带来生存风险。

body.en:
The boss of ChatGPT-maker OpenAI says people should have more faith in AI firms to keep the tech safe, amid rising public concerns about the risks.

"The world should trust that we are going to do the right thing because it's the right thing and we feel the magnitude of this," Sam Altman said on Tuesday during a conference in San Francisco.

He accepted people were justified in being concerned about AI, as the capability of the tools has progressed rapidly.

But critics say firms cannot be trusted to self-regulate, with left-wing Senator Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon, a former adviser of US President Donald Trump, among those calling for greater governance of AI.

Trump himself has criticised calls for more guardrails on the fast-moving technology, calling fears about AI's safety a "hoax".

Altman's comments on Tuesday came during an appearance at an annual conference hosted by software firm Salesforce.

"It doesn't take as much imagination as it used to for [us] to imagine how this could go wrong," he said. "I think the world is right to be afraid of this."

But AI bosses themselves have also admitted it may be difficult to regulate a technology which is changing so quickly.

In an interview with Axios published on 3 September , external , Altman said he had expected Congress to create a "basic framework" for advanced AI after his 2023 testimony, but that has yet to happen.

He suggested lawmakers have struggled to keep pace with the technology and to regulate it without "slow[ing] down innovation".

New safety legislation on AI is unlikely to emerge from the US Congress anytime soon, despite the fact lawmakers returned from their summer break on Monday.

There is a lack of consensus within both US parties on how any regulation would happen - and the House is set to enter recess again at the end of the week ahead of the midterm elections in early November.

Altman's comments on Tuesday were the first time he had spoken publicly since a post went viral last week by a researcher who quit the AI firm Anthropic. The researcher claimed AI could "kill all humans" by the end of the decade if left unchecked.

A handful of other AI executives and experts responded by saying they agreed with the assessment, though they didn't explain how they came to their conclusions or how exactly AI could accomplish such a thing.

After Altman's comments, Mark Zuckerberg wrote on X , external that every AI firm had the ability and the incentive "to take its own actions" towards safety.

"Any lab that doesn't focus on alignment will fall behind," the Meta chief executive wrote.

"Labs face significant liability if their models cause harm, so they have a strong incentive to prevent this as well."

Alignment is a field which aims to build human ethical ideas and principles...
body.zh: 英伟达老板黄仁勋表示，人工智能（AI）公司的负责人应该决定是否发布该技术的新版本，以回应人们对人工智能对人类威胁日益增长的担忧。 “我们不需要新的法律或法规，”黄说，并补充说，在人工智能产品的创新速度和安全性之间不应该有“错误的选择”。 按估值计算，英伟达是全球最大的公司，由于对其生产的人工智能计算芯片的需求旺盛，该公司的利润大幅增长。 黄仁勋对人工智能安全的立场与业内人士形成鲜明对比，后者最近表达了对该技术可能消灭人类的担忧。 一位退出人工智能公司 Anthropic 的人工智能研究人员的一篇帖子上周在网上疯传，该帖子声称，如果不加以控制，人工智能可能会在本世纪末杀死所有人类。 其他人工智能高管和专家回应称他们同意。然后，周末，Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 呼吁所有人工智能外部发展步伐放缓，并敦促政府监管该行业。 这篇文章得到了 OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman、谷歌 DeepMind Demis Hassabis 联合创始人以及社交媒体网站 X 和 AI 助手 Grok 所有者埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的赞赏。 然而，一些行业人士表示，这种担忧被夸大了，并被用来炒作该行业。 周二在旧金山举行的销售人员会议上，黄仁勋在谈到人工智能的潜在危险时，将当前的进步称为“一场新的工业革命”，但坚持认为人工智能公司应该从本质上进行自我监管。 他补充说，如果人工智能公司的领导者在任何时候对他们的产品缺乏信心，他们应该选择不发布该产品。 “这是一件非常明显的事情，”黄说。 “尽可能快地跑，但如果任何时候你觉得机构失控了，就停下来。” 让人工智能高管完全自我监管的想法在一些业内人士看来是个坏主意。 Anthropic 高管兼联合创始人杰克·克拉克 (Jack Clark) 周一对 BBC 表示，让人工智能成为一个“完全不受监管的行业”就像“掷骰子，风险巨大”。 由人工智能行业圣人 Yann LeCun 领导的 Logical Intelligence 首席商务官帕特里克·希尔曼 (Patrick Hillman) 周二指出，人们对科技公司做任何真正符合公共利益、外部利益的事情缺乏信心。 “当今美国人唯一可能比华盛顿更不信任的机构是硅谷。我在这两个地方工作和生活过，我向你们保证，你们都受到了这种怀疑，”希尔曼说。 “如果你认为你正在建造的东西是危险的，请告诉我们你准备停止做什么，”他补充道。 OpenAI 的领导者和...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, championed by leaders like Jensen Huang, brings immense praise and influence. Yet, as the technology's potential impact grows, so does the scrutiny. Proverbs 27:21 reminds us that a person is tested by the praise they receive. The challenge for innovators is to temper ambition with wisdom and responsibility, ensuring that the...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，在黄仁勋等领导者的推动下，带来了巨大的赞誉和影响力。然而，随着这项技术潜在影响的扩大，审查也随之增加。箴言27:21提醒我们，人受到的试炼在于他所受的称赞。创新者面临的挑战是将雄心与智慧和责任相结合，确保追求进步不会超越伦理考量。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: How chimps teach their kids tool tricks
title.zh: 黑猩猩如何教孩子使用工具的技巧

summary.en: Adult chimpanzees first demonstrate tool use, then hand over the implements to their infants, who copy the behavior, indicating social learning of technology.
summary.zh: 成年黑猩猩首先展示使用工具的技巧，然后将工具交给它们的幼崽，幼崽会模仿这些行为，这表明了技术是通过社会学习获得的。

body.en: Chimpanzees are known to use rudimentary tools when foraging for food. According to a new paper in the journal Frontiers in Psychology, this learned behavior is passed down from adults to offspring through social learning. Specifically, adult chimps deliberately model the behavior, then turn their tools over to the youngsters so they can mimic the same motions. "Receiving food and tools from experienced individuals, which we call food or tool transfer, may help chimpanzees learn to use technology to extract foods that are difficult to access,” said co-author Andreu Sánchez-Megías , a graduate student at the University of Barcelona and the Jane Goodall Institute Spain in Senegal. “Tool transfers thus appear to be a form of teaching, together with observation and supervised practice. It appears that mothers are the main models and teachers for young chimpanzees in this manner.” As we have previously reported , tool use was once thought to be one of the defining features of humans, although Charles Darwin observed chimpanzees using stones to crack nuts in 1871. In 1960, the late primatologist Jane Goodall observed a chimp named David Greybeard bend a twig, strip off the leaves, and use it to spoon termites out of a nest and into his mouth. When he learned of the behavior, Goodall's mentor, Louis Leakey, famously observed, “Now we must redefine ‘tool,’ redefine ‘man,’ or accept chimpanzees as humans.” Since then, chimps have been observed making sponges out of leaves to soak up liquids, shaping sticks to collect algae, and sharpening rudimentary spears for hunting.
